issue.title: Consolidate %model completion filtering in sase-core
issue.description: Provider-qualified %model completion now deliberately implements the same filtering rules in Python (src/sase/xprompt/model_completion.py) and the Rust xprompt LSP (crates/sase_xprompt_lsp/src/server.rs). The approved provider_qualified_model_completion plan kept that duplication for landing-order safety, but the boundary-correct end state is to move the shared filter into sase_core, expose it through sase_core_rs for Python/ACE, and have the LSP call the same core implementation. Scope: preserve the current provider-row catalog wire shape, alias gate, first-slash provider scoping, nested slash-bearing model fallback, and version-skew behavior; update Python callers/adapters and Rust/Python tests without changing %model routing semantics.

payload.close_reason: Fixed: the filter now lives in sase-core and both callers go through it. crates/sase_core/src/model_completion.rs exposes filter_model_completion_entries and filter_model_completion_candidates; the Rust LSP imports filter_model_completion_candidates from core (crates/sase_xprompt_lsp/src/server.rs:50); and the Python side is a pure adapter -- src/sase/xprompt/model_completion.py:160-173 marshals entries to the wire shape and delegates to require_rust_binding('filter_model_completion_entries'), preserving the provider-row catalog wire shape. The duplicated filtering rules the bead described are gone. Verified 2026-08-24 through /sase_repo.
